journey.name: M2 sign-up, logout, login and session persistence
journey.description: End-to-end check of the M2 auth flow against the local Docker backend (docker compose up). Uses a fresh username; change it if the account already exists.

actions.action: Verify that the login screen is shown with a "Username or email" field, a "Password" field and a "Log in" button
Verify that two "Required" error messages are shown
Verify that a "Create account" button is shown
Verify that the main app is shown with "Home", "Explore", "Create", "Activity" and "Profile" navigation items
Verify that the login screen is shown
Enter "journey.user" in the "Username or email" field
Verify that the main app is shown with the "Home" navigation item selected
Verify that the main app is shown without asking to log in again
